# Platform Next — full description

> Platform Next is an all-in-one network acceleration and privacy management platform. It lets users securely manage subscription links, configure multi-platform proxy clients, and access high-performance global server nodes with low latency and enterprise-grade encryption.

## What it is

Platform Next is a VPN / proxy subscription service with a web dashboard (https://platformnext.dev) and native apps. A user creates an account, buys a package (subscription plan) with the wallet balance, then imports the generated subscription link into the Platform Next app or a compatible third-party client. The dashboard shows traffic usage, expiry, connected devices and server status.

## Supported platforms

- iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux (native apps on the Download page: https://platformnext.dev/download/)
- Compatible third-party clients: Sing-box, Clash, Shadowrocket, Quantumult X, V2rayN and others (list: https://platformnext.dev/applications/)

## Protocols

Sing-box, Xray, V2Ray, Hysteria, TUIC, Reality, Trojan and SSH.

## Core features

1. Multi-platform client support — works on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux; compatible with Sing-box, Clash, Shadowrocket, Quantumult X and V2rayN.
2. Global low-latency network — worldwide server infrastructure with intelligent routing, high bandwidth and continuous uptime monitoring.
3. Strict privacy and encryption — modern encrypted protocols with a strict no-logs policy.
4. One-click subscriptions — import subscriptions into apps with automated node synchronisation (QR code or deep link), balance tracking and status monitoring.

## Account features (signed-in dashboard)

- Wallet: top up by bank transfer (VietQR), scratch card or PayPal; balance history; wallet-to-wallet transfer; gift codes.
- Packages: buy, renew, gift a package to another e-mail, discount codes, refunds, pause / resume a package.
- Subscriptions: subscription link + QR, import into apps, custom SNI, reset security / UUID, reset data, traffic and order history.
- Devices: see and sign out logged-in devices, upgrade the device limit.
- Affiliate: invitation codes, commission, leaderboard, withdrawals.
- Support: ticket system with chat, attachments and notifications.
- Sign in with username/e-mail and password, Google or Apple; e-mail verification codes for sign-up, password reset and account deletion.

## Languages

Vietnamese (default), English, Chinese.
